basic_details.job_title: NIT Silchar Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Computer Science and Engineering at National Institute of Technology Silchar has invited applications for one temporary Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post on an ANRF, Govt. of India, sponsored project. The pay is Rs. 37,000/- per month (+10% HRA as per the Institute norms). The essential qualification is an M.Tech./M.E. in CSE/IT/ECE, or a B.Tech/B.E. in CSE/IT/ECE with a valid GATE score. Indian citizens apply by emailing the Principal Investigator; the soft-copy application must be received by 11 December 2026.

how_to_apply: Fill in the Format of Application printed with the notice (pages 2 and 3). It asks for the advertisement number, project title, funding agency, department, personal and address details, educational qualification from Class X, NET/GATE details, employment details and a declaration with signature. A recent passport-size colour photograph is pasted on it.
If you belong to SC/ST/OBC/EWS/PwD, attach the certificate, as the form asks.
Email the duly filled-in application form, along with your CV and soft copies of all supporting documents, to the Principal Investigator at [email protected].
Write this subject line: “Application for the Post of Junior Research Fellow (JRF) under the Project ANRF/IRG/2025/001760/ENS”.
Make sure the soft copy is received by 11.12.2026.
Queries go to the Principal Investigator at [email protected].
important_instructions: No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview and/or joining the post. Employed candidates must submit a no objection certificate from the employer at the time of interview. Selected candidates have to sign an agreement at the time of joining. The Institute has the discretion to restrict the number of candidates shortlisted for interview.

content_sections.heading: About NIT Silchar
content_sections.text: The project aims to develop a reliable, privacy-preserving, and resource-efficient Split Federated Learning framework for UAV-assisted Vehicular Edge Networks. The Principal Investigator is Dr. Moirangthem Biken Singh.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Applications are invited from Indian citizens. The essential qualification is one of the following. The age limit is 30 years on the last date of application. The notice gives relaxation on qualification and age as per Govt. of India Rules. Employed candidates must submit a no objection certificate from their employer at the time of interview. For discipline-specific eligibility, candidates should check the official notification.

rows.essential_qualification: (a) M.Tech./M.E. degree in CSE/IT/ECE, with a minimum of 65% marks or 6.5 CPI (on a 10-point scale) at the M.Tech./M.E. level; OR (b) B.Tech/B.E. degree in CSE/IT/ECE, with a valid GATE score, and a minimum of 75% marks or 7.5 CPI (on a 10-point scale) at the B.Tech/B.E. level
rows.desirable: Project experience in Deep Learning, Python Programming, & UAV-based applications

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The JRF post carries Rs. 37,000/- per month (+10% HRA as per the Institute norms). The post is temporary, for 03 years: initially for one year, extendable annually based on performance. Selected candidates sign an agreement at the time of joining. All terms and conditions are as per the guidelines of the sponsoring agency and NIT Silchar.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NIT Silchar Junior Research Fellow (JRF)
content_sections.text: Queries go to the Principal Investigator at [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The Institute may restrict the number of candidates shortlisted for the interview on the basis of screening. The interview date and mode (online/offline), with other details, will be notified through email. No candidate may be recruited if suitable candidates are not found. Employed candidates bring a no objection certificate from their employer at the time of interview.
